new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients (DAR) Q1 2026 Earnings: Swing to Profitability Driven by Diamond Green Diesel and Renewable Fuel Regulations
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 net income of $134.31M (vs. loss prior year), with revenue of $1,550.82M. Strong performance in Diamond Green Diesel joint venture under supportive renewable fuel regulations drove the profit inflection. Management projects $4–6B cash generation 2027–2030.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Details Transformation Into Global Leader in Rendering, Collagen and Renewable Fuels at Investor Day
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients held its May 11, 2026 Investor Day, highlighting Diamond Green Diesel and collagen demand as key growth drivers, supported by global scale and favorable renewables policy backdrop. The company emphasized ~1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel capacity and early SAF adoption.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Announces Full SEC Reporting Status, Strengthening Marketability and Positioning Company for Expansion in Renewable and Nutritional Energy Markets
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy Inc. (OTC: BRLL) announced achievement of full SEC reporting status, a milestone supporting market visibility and investor engagement. Company previously acquired Happy Traps in March 2026, a waste-to-energy firm specializing in grease trap cleanings and fats/oils/grease recovery for 200+ commercial clients.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients (DAR) Up 6.7% After Q1 Swing Back to Profitability; Bull Case Reassessment
new_news.summary: Q1 2026 earnings showed sharp move from loss to profit, helped by stronger core ingredients and Diamond Green Diesel performance under supportive renewable fuel regulations. Equity analyst assesses whether profit rebound and margin recovery shift the investment narrative.

new_news.headline: Step-by-Step Guide to Grease Trap Cleaning
new_news.summary: Educational guide on grease trap maintenance procedures, cleaning schedules, and regulatory compliance. Addresses FOG content thresholds (25% rule) and professional servicing protocols.
